choice_feedback.b: Azure Advisor provides broad optimization recommendations, but Defender for Cloud is the security-focused service described here.
choice_feedback.c: Azure Policy evaluates resource configuration compliance; it does not provide the full security-posture and workload-protection experience.
choice_feedback.d: Azure Monitor collects and analyzes operational telemetry; it is not the central cloud-security posture service.
